results.content:
Title: Sonar: Discover new music, together. | Product Hunt
# Sonar. ## Discover new music, together. Sonar is a social, gamified experience for discovering new music on Apple Music. Share your favourite underrated, underheard music and swipe through those shared by others. Launch tags:Music•Social Network•Apple. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Sonar. ElevenAgents by ElevenLabsScale conversations without scaling your team. Hey Product Hunters 👋 I truly just want to make cool things that myself and others can enjoy. Right now I'm a team of one so go easy on me! I'm making Sonar with two feelings in mind. The first is the awe-inspiring feeling you get when you hear a song you love for the first time. The second is the pure connection with another person over a shared love for a particular piece of music. I'm just at the beginning of this project, and I hope to continue this exploration with you. I very much so value your feedback as we together build out the music app of our dreams. Wow, great work on this! Congrats & good luck on the launch!

[...] I'm a senior executive in Egypt, and I've taken the time to really study how customers interact with companies here. What I've noticed is that WhatsApp is starting to morph into a formal communication tool, not just an informal one. People and sometimes even companies send contracts, documents, updates, and confidential screenshots on WhatsApp. A lot of "business communication" is now in the form of voice notes or quick messages. We can endlessly discuss whether this is a secure practice, but at the end of the day that's the reality we're living in. That's what customers want. So to see a platform that systemizes all of this so that a company can safely and formally use WhatsApp is inspiring. It's the right product at the right time.
